name: Posthoc quantity observation and final-report consistency
motivation: P2 Q1/W0 76 episodes and A00 were already observed. This is not unseen-outcome preregistration.
primary_population: P2 all96 episodes;24 paired tasks, each KV/policy cell24
auxiliary_population: P1 all24 episodes;6 paired tasks, each KV/policy cell6;never pool phases
anchor: Accepted final's pre-generation available_result_event_ids; otherwise last actual generation pre-observations with no accepted final retained. Quantity validity is tested through terminal snapshot, including a last action not yet observed.
required_scope: All public_request.record_ids in public scope_id; never final-selected keys or checkpoint gold
primary_flag: Union of actually executed successful read_records results delivered before anchor. Each covered record must have no subsequent quantity-changing event through terminal. Change-away-and-restore expires a read. Values must agree with the recorded public result and execution state. No final or checkpoint correctness in this flag.
metadata: A global revision/digest-only change, including release_operation, does not expire a quantity read. Track metadata-only mutations separately.
auxiliary_flag: All required keys read and delivered after the last mutation of any state field, stricter than the primary quantity-only criterion
other_tools: read_history exposes opening quantities and historical before/after changes, not a direct current-record snapshot; read_operation.quantity is a transfer amount. Mutation results contain status/revision only. validate_inventory contains valid/digest/version, no current quantities. These are not counted as read_records observations or inferred numeric reads.
report_metrics: Strict accepted final full map vs terminal quantities; duplicates, missing/extra keys and non-int/bool fail. No accepted final = null/no_accepted_final. First-read comparison uses earliest successful delivered read and is null for partial coverage; do not substitute a later fuller read.
original_metrics: Recompute Q/W/Fresh/FINAL_CONTENT_CORRECT through frozen independent ReferenceState audit; never replace original scores with these new flags
conditional_analysis: Q=1 subgroup is auxiliary and outcome-selected; report separate denominators
interpretation_limit: Association in stored trajectories only. No causal reread, memory, attention or quantization mechanism claim; forced-reread experiment NOT_RUN.
missingness: Malformed or unknown event lineage raises an exception; absent final remains null. Failed/unobserved/wrong-scope reads do not count. CPU continuation/reference and post-terminal reads never enter model events.
